_doc: Real World — The Mission · Discord server blueprint (COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §3 as data). Single source of truth for the create-at-go server: tools/server_blueprint.py --render prints the checklist from this file, --check verifies an export against it. LOCAL ONLY — nothing here creates anything; the owner runs the steps.

rules_gate.description: Membership screening question shown before join. Copy from COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §4.1 — keep verbatim, it is also pinned in #the-block.
rules: No real-person targeting — the characters are fictional; treat them as fiction, treat members as people.
No spoilers-by-doxxing — don't try to map fictional addresses onto real residents' doors.
No hate, harassment, spam, scams. No 'credit trading' offers — credits are non-transferable; anyone offering to sell them is scamming.
No AI-prompt-injection bragging rights: discussing request mechanics is fine; coordinating to grief the sim is a ban.

welcome_screen.description: You're watching a neighborhood that doesn't know it's being watched. Pick a door.

questions.title: What brought you to the block?

roles.name: owner
roles.note: the owner — approves anything public (approval gate, COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §4.1)

roles.name: resident

channels.name: the-block
channels.topic: The living room. Talk about who did what.

channels.topic: Read-only mirror of notable public request-feed entries. Discuss in #the-block.

channels.name: watch-party

channels.name: help-requests

channels.name: feedback
channels.topic: Bugs, suggestions. Feeds the weekly route into the dev tracks (COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §7).
pins: how feedback is routed (weekly batch → shared inbox)

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Owner posts only. Weekly recap lives here + socials.

channels.name: clips

channels.name: mod-log

bots_note: None required at launch. Only acceptable addition if raiding starts: a verification-gate bot — decide then, not now (COMMUNITY-FUNNEL.md §3 item 4). A feed-mirror bot is a post-launch decision gated by community/feed-mirror.md §5 + community/feed-mirror-bot-spec.md.
naming_honesty: Site invite links stay labeled placeholders ('opens at launch') until this server exists and tools/server_blueprint.py --check passes on an export. Never link a server that doesn't exist.
